title: Caleb Conquers Hebron and Debir
description: Caleb son of Jephunneh receives Hebron (Kiriath-Arba) as his inheritance among the descendants of Judah and drives out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. Then he moves against Debir (formerly Kiriath-Sepher) and promises his daughter Achsah to whoever captures the city. Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, takes the city and marries Achsah. Achsah asks her father for a field and water springs, and Caleb gives her both the upper and lower springs.
